about.en: UNHon is the Ondo tokenized stock for UnitedHealth Group, issued by Ondo Global Markets (BVI) Limited on the Ondo Global Markets platform and offered to eligible non-US investors. It is backed by UNH shares and is a total-return tracker: it gives the economic exposure of holding UnitedHealth shares with dividends reinvested, so one token does not necessarily equal one share. It is deployed on Ethereum (0x075756F3b6381a79633438fAA8964946bf40163d), BNB Chain and Solana.
